an6.117:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo kāye kāyānupassī viharituṃ.
an6.117:1.3: kammārāmataṃ, bhassārāmataṃ, niddārāmataṃ, saṅgaṇikārāmataṃ, indriyesu aguttadvārataṃ, bhojane amattaññūtaṃ.
an6.117:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme appahāya abhabbo kāye kāyānupassī viharituṃ.
an6.117:2.1: cha bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo kāye kāyānupassī viharituṃ.
an6.117:2.3: kammārāmataṃ, bhassārāmataṃ, niddārāmataṃ, saṅgaṇikārāmataṃ, indriyesu aguttadvārataṃ, bhojane amattaññutaṃ.
an6.117:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme pahāya bhabbo kāye kāyānupassī viharitunti.
